current_state: R2_11_ACQUISITION_PLANNED (this Phase-0 freeze stops here; capture/sealing/opening/evaluation are future phases, explicitly not performed now)

determinism_repeat_requirements.minimum: at least one repeated workload per category (4 total: one coding, one reasoning, one summarization, one instruction-following) at the primary 4 GiB budget, plus representative secondary-budget repeats (at least one cell at 1.5 GiB and one at 8 GiB).

execution_architecture.atomic_per_cell_persistence: Each (workload, budget, policy) cell is written as its own complete, atomically-renamed result record (write-to-temp-then-rename pattern, mirroring R2-BRIDGE-01's incremental read-modify-write pattern under the sandboxed-environment timeout constraints already observed in that phase), so partial progress survives a timeout or interruption.
execution_architecture.checkpointed: Progress is checkpointed after every cell (not batched), because the R2-BRIDGE-01 phase empirically showed that even a 3-cell batch could hit the sandboxed 180s per-call budget mid-run; R2-11's 72-cell matrix is sized assuming the same per-cell-checkpoint discipline.
execution_architecture.concurrent_writer_protection: Strictly sequential execution, one cell at a time, matching R2-BRIDGE-01's and R2-10's own 'no parallel writers' rule; no two processes write the same result file concurrently.
execution_architecture.deterministic: For identical trace/budget/baseline/predictor/retention-policy/configuration, scientific replay outputs must be bit-identical (run_fast()/run_fast_bridge() are both already proven deterministic and side-effect-free on inputs).
execution_architecture.duplicate_cell_protection: Before computing a cell, the executor checks whether a result record for that exact (workload_id, budget, policy, config_digest) key already exists and is well-formed; if so, it is reused rather than recomputed, and never silently overwritten.
execution_architecture.no_full_tournament_state_in_memory: The executor processes and persists one cell at a time; it does not require holding all 72 cells' intermediate state in memory simultaneously.

expected_future_evaluation_matrix.note: 12 workloads x 3 budgets x 2 policies = 72. If O_B is included as a secondary comparator, it is recorded separately and does not affect policy selection, because no policy selection exists in R2-11 (instruction #23). No alternative policies may be added after opening EVAL.

memory_correctness_requirements: resident bytes <= configured budget for every cell
overflow accounting valid (overflow_misses tracked and consistent with resident/budget state)
expert sizes correct (reused from the already-validated fast_replay/retention_policies expert-size accounting)
protected experts cannot create hidden overcommit (PredictedProtectPolicy's protection set is bounded and accounted for within the same budget enforcement as any other resident expert)
invalid configuration fails closed (e.g. an unrecognized budget or policy config raises rather than silently defaulting)
